documentsRequired: As required on the official portal
title: UP Income, Cast, Residential Certificate Online Verification 2026
organization: Government of Uttar Pradesh / e-District UP
postName: Income / Caste / Residence Certificate – Online Apply & Verification
vacancyDetails: e-District services for Income, Caste and Domicile/Residential certificates in Uttar Pradesh
howToApply:
1. Visit https://edistrict.up.gov.in or https://jansunwai.up.gov.in related services
2. Register / login with mobile
3. Apply for Income / Caste / Residence certificate
4. Upload required proofs and submit
5. Verify issued certificate online with application/certificate number
shortDescription: UP Income, Caste and Residential Certificate online apply & verification 2026 via e-District Uttar Pradesh portal.
content:
Residents of Uttar Pradesh can apply for and verify Income, Caste and Residential (Domicile) certificates online through the state e-District / service portals.

Common uses

  • Scholarships and fee concessions
  • Government job applications
  • Admissions and reservation benefits

Use official portals only. Keep Aadhaar, photo and supporting affidavits/proofs ready. Verify certificates using the certificate number before submitting elsewhere.
